required.name: selected_runtime_path
required.description: Target runtime path to verify (Path 1 Official Blender Lab MCP 5.1+, Path 2 mcp-for-blender 3.0+, or CLI appendix)

required.name: observed_environment_signals
required.description: Observed Blender version, enabled add-on state, MCP host configuration, and tool surface signals

optional.name: port_or_session_diagnostics
optional.description: Optional port 9876 listener status or active Blender session count

optional.name: host_client_environment
optional.description: User MCP host application (Claude Desktop Connector, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or manual client)

optional.name: installed_blender_version
optional.description: Installed Blender version used to check the Blender 5.1+ floor for Path 1 vs 3.0+ for Path 2

optional.name: blender_version_posture
optional.description: Installed or available Blender version (e.g., 5.1+, 4.2 LTS, 3.6 LTS, or unknown)

optional.name: host_environment_category
optional.description: Available MCP client host (Claude Desktop Connector, manual MCP IDE client, or headless CI)

optional.name: organizational_policy_constraints
optional.description: Optional security or IT constraints restricting third-party add-ons or interactive GUI sessions

optional.name: path_one_host_option
optional.description: Selected Path 1 host mode: option (a) Anthropic Connector in Claude Desktop or option (b) manual MCP client

optional.name: blender_5_1_addon_posture
optional.description: Confirmation that Official Blender Lab MCP add-on in Blender 5.1+ is required by both host options

optional.name: mcp_client_name
optional.description: Specific MCP client for host option (b) such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Zed

optional.name: target_blender_instance
optional.description: Running Blender session identifier or binary path experiencing bridge or port collisions

optional.name: configured_mcp_hosts_and_addons
optional.description: Inventory of enabled Blender add-ons (Lab MCP vs mcp-for-blender) and active MCP client connections

optional.name: port_9876_diagnostics
optional.description: Optional socket/port binding diagnostics around default port 9876

optional.name: target_blend_scene_and_outputs
optional.description: Source .blend file expectations and target render/export output deliverables

optional.name: execution_environment_constraints
optional.description: Headless CI, render node, or local batch constraints selected via setting-up-blender-runtime

optional.name: frame_range_or_batch_items
optional.description: Optional frame range or batch variant list for headless execution
